summary: Completed WU14-05 Device Detail tabs, query gating, and Historical containment.
completed: Refactored Device Detail into persistent actions and Overview, Monitoring, Services, Containers, System, and Activity tabpanels.
Gated Historical mounting to Monitoring and persisted Activity mounting to Activity; retained snapshot/background monitoring behavior without new refresh loops.
Added containment to Historical cards/charts and recorded deterministic before/after request counts.

validationCommands.summary: 10 focused Activity-gating, stale-device, settled-query, range, and containment tests pass.
Canonical Rust/frontend/AIQT/diff validation passed; lint has four pre-existing warnings.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Six accessible tabpanels expose Overview, Monitoring, Services, Containers, System, and Activity; administration remains persistent.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Historical and Activity load only on their tabs
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Historical components mount only in Monitoring; Activity hook has an inactive no-request path and mounts only in Activity.
The refactor reuses useDeviceSnapshots and existing refresh action without creating effects, timers, or scheduler calls.
Historical cards, grid and chart use min-width-zero/overflow containment; long-series regression covers 160 points.

notes: Risk score: 42/100 (medium): Device Detail UI composition changed, but typed backend boundaries and background monitoring semantics were retained.
The in-memory router remains the native route mechanism; tab state is component-local because introducing a parallel URL router is out of scope for this architecture.
